name: Find an apartment with budget
tagline: Hunts budget apartments by weighing rent, commute time and neighborhood safety
description: Anchor the search on your workplace, set a price ceiling and the longest commute you will accept, and it hunts for apartments that fit. Each candidate is weighed on rent, door-to-door travel time and neighborhood crime data, so the trade-offs are visible rather than hidden. The sharer built it for their own move.
author: TheAyoFrancis
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
